Drawing DWG-A-0003 rev A, sheet 1/1: System A – anode loop schematic.
Components:
- A-EXH: Exhaust outlet
- A-H2S: Hydrogen supply
- A-STK: Fuel cell stack
- A-PRG: Anode purge valve
- A-HRB: Hydrogen recirculation blower
Line list:
- L06 Hydrogen from A-H2S (Hydrogen supply) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L07 Anode recirculation from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower)
- L08 Anode recirculation from A-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L09 Purge gas from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-PRG (Anode purge valve)
- L10 Purge gas from A-PRG (Anode purge valve) to A-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
